_source: Synthetic plans as a careful model would write them for examples/briefs/*.md: headlines as conclusions, paraphrased lines, figures of the brief and values derived from two of them (a difference, a percent change, a ratio), a chart on the brief's own series, a table copied from the brief. Grounding must keep every slide and every figure of these plans.
